tools.name: get_referral_code
tools.description: The UnderHyper referral code for Hyperliquid (and trade.xyz, which shares Hyperliquid's referral system) with the documented benefit, the sign-up link and the date the link was last tested. Pass venue for another app we have a code for, or "all".

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Mark price, 24h change, 24h notional volume, open interest (USD, one side; the Hyperliquid API counts longs plus shorts, so its raw figure is twice this), current funding (hourly and annualized) and max leverage for one Hyperliquid perp. Core coins by name (BTC, ETH, HYPE); HIP-3 markets as dex:COIN

tools.name: get_funding
tools.description: Current Hyperliquid funding for one coin (hourly rate, paid every hour, and simple annualized rate), or with no coin the live markets with the highest and lowest funding among those with at least $1M 24h volume. Positive = longs pay shorts.

tools.name: list_hip3_dexes
tools.description: Every HIP-3 (builder-deployed) perp dex on Hyperliquid: name, deployer, live and delisted market counts, 24h volume, open interest, share of HIP-3 volume and the top markets. Delisted markets are excluded from totals.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find UnderHyper pages (guides, explainers, markets, ecosystem apps, comparisons, news, datasets) for a question or keyword. Returns titles, one-line summaries and URLs; read the page for its dated short answer.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: list_hip3_dexes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: list_hip3_dexes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
